import math

fy_1981_bc = box_cox(fy_1981, lambda_val)

# Difference: 1981 - 1980
diff = fy_1981_bc - fy_1980_bc
print(f"\nDifference (1981 - 1980): {diff}")

# Round to 4 decimal places
